trails.note: Painted cut the magenta uphill-route dashes run on (dash centroids as skeleton, checked against snow-pixel runs; centred within ~10 px). Starts at the Sky Haus/tram top (2058,118), follows the summit ridge ESE, drops through the narrow cut beside the orange line where the 1st label's square sits (2296,317) (the magenta route itself uses a parallel cut ~40 px west), joins the wide cut at the 2nd label (2353,421), runs ESE below Poma Line past (2814,647) to the hairpin (2911,747), back SW past (2728,951) to the JFK junction (2682,1040), SE past (2804,1126), south along the yellow boundary to (2970,1319), SW past (2714,1655) and the Kokomo/Deer Run junctions, then along the slow-zone band midway between the magenta and yellow lines past the green-circle label (2062,1984) to the Flyer Express Quad base (1952,2072). Passes all 7 printed labels: the label list merged two pairs ([2402,368] = labels at y 316 and 421; [2844,1038] = labels at y 951 and 1126).

Printed twice, not once: blue square at (2231,1049) and black diamond at (2218,1163) (the label list averaged them into [2342,1106]). Both symbols sit in the open cut on the EAST side of the Flyer lift that splits off Upper Exhibition at ~(2195,907); Upper/Lower Exhibition's own symbols (2114,977)/(2075,1217) sit in the cut along the WEST side of the lift, and Racer's symbol (2153,1271) in the middle strip that branches SW off this cut at y~1120-1160. Traced that east cut (snow-run midpoints) from the split, past both labels, down to where it opens into the slow zone at (2178,1345) (top of Deer Run/Bushwacker). The exact top (where it separates from Upper Exhibition) is a judgment call.

Leaves the Upper Exhibition/GMB cut at its upper label diamond (2243,935), runs down a narrow strip at x~2285 to y~1040, then the light-blue diagonal cut SE to (2525,1199), bends down through the lower label diamond (2581,1295) and follows the wide white cut SE (Kokomo crosses it at ~(2700,1445)) to join Ullr's Dream at (2800,1578). Centre from snow-pixel run midpoints, checked on zoomed crops.

Clear open cut running south from the slow zone at (2152,1385) (bottom of the Exhibition/Racer/GMB area), past its label square (2162,1655), to Ullr's Dream's slow-zone band at (2128,1955). Checked on zoomed crops and a coarse snow map.

Follows the green-dotted slow-zone corridor its label (2255,1486) sits in: from the bottom of the Exhibition/GMB/Racer cuts (2172,1372) SE down the band centre (dot-density midpoints) to where the band merges into Ullr's Dream at (2456,1772). The band is ~60-80 px wide; start point is where the corridor leaves the broad slow zone.

Upper part: a clear open channel leaving Ullr's Dream at (2816,1130) (just below its (2804,1126) label) south to the upper Kokomo label (2770,1368). It then crosses the Northwest Passage cut SW (~(2700,1445)) and follows a lighter, sparsely treed corridor (glade-like painting, found on a smoothed snow map) SW through the lower label (2597,1587) to Ullr's Dream at (2521,1746). Upper channel is certain; the lower corridor is subtle.

NO CUT: the label (3053,980) sits in dense painted trees between the Ullr's Dream hairpin (2911,747), the orange gravest-concern line and the yellow boundary; no open snow to follow (checked colour crops and snow-pixel map). Presumably a glade from the open area just east of the hairpin (~(2940,770)) down to Ullr's Dream near (2900-2950,1150-1250), but no line is drawn.
